english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being number one in an ordered series, such as being the first person to arrive.
Use this when something is first in an order or series, rather than main or fundamental.
Use this when “prime” means first in a time sequence, order, or series.

examples.english: I was the first to arrive at the office.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 dou3 gung1 si1

examples.english: This is the primary episode in the whole series.
examples.traditional: 呢個係成個系列第一集。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 sing4 go3 hai6 lit6 dai6 jat1 zaap6

examples.english: The first person to sign up gets prime choice of seats.
examples.traditional: 第一個報名嘅人可以優先揀位。
examples.jyutping: dai6 jat1 go3 bou3 meng2 ge3 jan4 ho2 ji5 jau1 sin1 gaan2 wai2
